purpose: Retain complete sanitized CDP V8 CPU profile data around the existing actual active-Markdown burst, outside the formal performance distribution.

capturePlan.profileStart: After setup frames, mutation observer arming, and delta construction; immediately before dispatch of 30 item/delta frames plus the terminal completion frame.
capturePlan.profileStop: After a changed assistant-row text mutation containing the final marker is observed and the existing two requestAnimationFrame opportunities complete.
capturePlan.externalChecks: Row geometry, last-character visibility, jump/tail gate, and tail polling happen after Profiler.stop and are timestamped separately. The profiled interval includes app-facing mock dispatch and bounded observer/two-RAF instrumentation.

urlPolicy: Raw script URLs are omitted. Only an exact manifest-approved served bundle-relative path or a status value is retained; callFrame fields are allow-listed.
